postShow.title: Vendor dump
postShow.body: A vendor's folding tables collapse into fire-sale energy. Quick flips, quicker cash.

postShow.title: Beer share
postShow.body: Someone's cooler runneth over. Your crew accepts communion from the lot.

postShow.title: Burrito angel
postShow.body: A burrito angel appears with foil-wrapped mercy. Hunger delayed, vibe improved.

postShow.title: Lot fam hookup
postShow.body: Lot fam slides you a little something for the next leg. No questions, all love.

postShow.title: Parking ticket
postShow.body: Orange slip on the windshield. The city always collects its encore.

postShow.title: Miracle sticker trade
postShow.body: You trade stickers like currency and walk away with a miracle ticket someone didn't need.

postShow.title: Quiet lot
postShow.body: The lot exhales. Vendors packing, stragglers humming. Nothing wild — just space to hustle.

postShow.title: After-party at the {djBand} DJ set
postShow.body: {djBand} spinning deep cuts in somebody's lot camp. The cooler is open and your crew is welcome. Everyone's dragging this morning.

postShow.title: After-party — {djBand} in the lot
postShow.body: {djBand} doing a late-night set, someone's firing a grill. Your crew eats well but didn't sleep much.

postShow.title: {djBand} after-party
postShow.body: {djBand} laid down a set so good someone floated you a balloon. You didn't ask. They insisted. The crew is gassed but not rested.

postShow.title: After-party flip — {djBand} set
postShow.body: {djBand} drew a crowd. You sold off some extra supplies to the late arrivals. Good night, rough morning.

postShow.title: After-party — {djBand} in the lot
postShow.body: {djBand} was vibing but some dude at the edge of the crowd sold your crew 'crystals' for $20. Classic. Everyone feels terrible.

postShow.title: After-party — {djBand} DJ set
postShow.body: {djBand} crushed it but someone in that crowd was absolutely cooked. One of your crew woke up rough. Everyone else isn't far behind.

lot.title: Clown Juice Mafia has arrived!
lot.body: Skull-painted cart under a palm tree. Buy balloons ($30) or try to make a deal (3 for $10 — sometimes a beer seals it).

lot.title: Lot buzz
lot.body: Vendors shouting, tape decks humming, someone selling pins out of a hatchback. Normal shakedown energy.

lot.title: Quiet lot
lot.body: The lot's mellow. Time to scout prices and plan the hustle before showtime.
